description: React UI dashboard for tunnel status and route management

requirements.title: Tunnel health overview panel
requirements.description: Top-level panel showing: tunnel status (healthy/degraded/critical), HA connections gauge, error rate, RTT, uptime, management mode badge

requirements.title: Health status badge
requirements.description: Display color-coded health status badge (green=healthy, yellow=degraded, red=critical) as primary visual indicator

requirements.title: Health metric cards
requirements.description: Show HA connections, error rate, RTT, and uptime as individual metric cards with values

requirements.title: Management mode display
requirements.description: Show current management mode (local/remote) as a badge in the health overview

requirements.title: Route status table
requirements.description: Table/list of all published routes showing: subdomain, scenario name, port, internal probe status, external probe status, last checked timestamp. Color-coded by status (green/yellow/red).

requirements.title: Route column display
requirements.description: Show subdomain, scenario name, port, and probe status columns in the route table

requirements.title: Status color coding in table
requirements.description: Color-code probe status cells (green/yellow/red) based on internal and external probe results

requirements.title: Last checked timestamp
requirements.description: Show relative time since last probe check for each route row

requirements.title: Recovery event timeline
requirements.description: Chronological list of recent recovery events showing: timestamp, trigger, action, outcome. Filterable by date range.

requirements.title: Port compliance audit view
requirements.description: Panel showing audit results: compliant/non-compliant/missing routes with details. Includes 'Run Audit' button for on-demand checks.

requirements.title: Route management form
requirements.description: Add/edit/remove routes from the manifest via the UI. Includes validation (no duplicate subdomains/ports) and 'Sync Config' button.

requirements.title: Form input validation
requirements.description: Validate form inputs: no duplicate subdomains/ports, valid port ranges, required fields

requirements.title: Inline validation error display
requirements.description: Show validation errors inline next to form fields with descriptive messages

requirements.title: Config sync trigger
requirements.description: Sync Config button triggers config push to cloudflared (local or remote mode)
